mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_audience_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND audience_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT FROM marketing_audience_snapshot a WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND audience_id>#{after} AND version=(SELECT MAX(a2.version) FROM marketing_audience_snapshot a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND a2.audience_id=a.audience_id) ORDER BY audience_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.audience_id,a.version,a.source,a.watermark,a.valid_until,(m.member_id IS NOT NULL) matched FROM marketing_audience_snapshot a LEFT JOIN marketing_audience_member m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.audience_id=a.audience_id AND m.version=a.version AND m.member_id=#{member} WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (a.audience_id,a.version) IN (#{ref.id},#{ref.version}) ORDER BY a.audience_id,a.version
SELECT rule_id,version,name,rule_json,status FROM marketing_rule_asset WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND rule_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_rule_asset SET status='PUBLISHED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND rule_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT rule_id,version,name,rule_json,status FROM marketing_rule_asset r WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND rule_id>#{after} AND version=(SELECT MAX(r2.version) FROM marketing_rule_asset r2 WHERE r2.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND r2.rule_id=r.rule_id) ORDER BY rule_id LIMIT #{limit}
